rules.question: Which stored listings does a report page show?
rules.decision: concept audit M08 (code-only, D114 fix wave, task G6); D115 (task A2-2 moved the owner to report::listed_records); REPORT-ALL-T4 renamed it report::library_lookup
must_match: auto rows = store->list_records(std::nullopt, cap, lens, order, true);
rules.note: The store lists results the library doesn't list, and every page drops them through ChartIndex::lists. A second loop over the store's records could forget the drop or key the hash another way. The SQL side of the same question (charts.md5 = results.hyhash) is store.json's not_in_library row.
